Create ONE flat complete widescreen presentation slide image, aspect 16:9, conceptually 1920x1080. This is revision 2 of a client-facing Chinese Airtap brand concept proposal called Taps Back. THE USER'S CORRECTION: too many pictures and mascots previously; the narrative and consistent typography/spacing must now lead. Therefore this whole new deck is deliberately typography-led, sparse, calm, precise, and serious.
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLE: the supplied Figma screenshot is STYLE reference for Satoshi type shapes, font weights, margins, negative space, warm-white/black/blue palette. It is NOT a layout to reproduce, and NOT permission to include the hand mascot. DO NOT copy website navigation, Meet Airtap buttons, any hero mascot, giant pale background word, UI photographs, or any non-specified content.
CONSISTENT STYLE RULES:
- Uniform flat warm white background #FAF9F5 on EVERY page. Near-black text #030405; precise saturated blue #0056F6 only for 1-2 key phrases or small numbers. Pale #D6E0F5 and gray #D8DADF for quiet hairlines if needed. NO forest green, sage, cream paper texture, gradients, dark slides, shadows, rounded card boxes, stickers, ornamental shapes.
- ALL text is SANS-SERIF. English uses Satoshi 500 and 800, stylistic set ss01 with single-storey a as seen in reference. Chinese uses a restrained modern blackface sans matching PingFang SC / Source Han Sans, consistent weights regular 400 and bold 650-700. NEVER use Chinese Song/Ming/serif, calligraphy or English serif. Do not vary the font families between pages.
- Strict grid: 96px virtual left/right margins (5% of width), 72px top safe margin. Small section label at x96,y72 about24px. All normal-page titles start x96,y160, use80px/100px leading, not absurdly oversized; body36px/54px, little labels24px. Body groups start around y430-480. Column gutters72px. Vertical spacing repeated 24,48,72,96. Footer x96 at y1012, small20px, exact "Airtap / Taps Back"; 2-digit page number at x1800 on same baseline. Never crowd footer. Generous negative space is intentional; do not fill it with pictures.
- Most pages contain just 1 main statement, supporting exact text, and/or a simple typographic relationship. Pure information design, with fine rules or arrows only if requested.
- NO photographs, NO 3D objects, NO hands, NO mascots, NO phones, NO icons, NO illustrations, NO product screenshots, NO decorative graphics, unless this individual page explicitly allows ONE small hand specimen.
- Perfect readable Simplified Chinese, accurate punctuation and exact supplied text. Do not add extra labels, duplicate copy, new slogans, metrics or research. This is a brand proposal, not a claim of validated capabilities.
- Present only the slide, no editor UI, no perspective mockup, no borders outside the canvas.
PAGE 01 / COVER, pure type with no imagery.
Use the exact small top-left label "AIRTAP / 品牌概念提案". Content left-aligned on the 96px margin, not center aligned.
At y250 a very large Satoshi800 title "Taps Back." in near-black, about176px font, restrained tracking matching reference.
At y490 a two-line slogan: "Your apps make you tap." in Satoshi500, size44px; below with24px gap "Airtap taps back." in Satoshi800,size64px, blue #0056F6.
At y740 clean Chinese36px copy "接手生活里反复发生的数字操作。"
Leave the RIGHT 30% and plenty of lower space completely empty. No mascot of any size. No line art. This sparse typographic confidence is the intended finish.
Footer exact "Airtap / Taps Back" and page "01".
